ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% high-intensity (cream/white) to 30% low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant central low-intensity black wedge originating at the fluke base and feathered into the mid-lobes. Solid black bands along the trailing edge of the left lobe. Mottled black pigmentation along the right lobe's trailing edge. Distinct small circular black cluster in the upper-right region of the right lobe lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped notch with an internal pixel angle of approximately 105 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, jagged serrations with varying amplitudes along the left trailing edge; more rounded, lower-frequency undulations along the right trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lobed curve exhibiting initial convexity from the central notch, transitioning to a slight concavity before tapering into sharp, upward-angled distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast clusters of textured yellowish-brown pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized on the terminal tips of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified barnacle clusters on both distal tips; distinct circular pigment mark on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, clear, open-centered dark ring-shaped pigmentation mark (approx. 15 pixels in diameter) on the upper mid-section of the right lobe.
